free_tier.stated: Decentralized GPU marketplace matched through EigenLayer AVS bids, with pay-per-second billing and no free allowance: the first step after signup is to add credits, 'minimum $15, maximum $5,000 per transaction', by card or USDC. An RTX 4090 is about USD 0.52 per hour.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: USD 15 at USD 0.52 per hour is about 28 hours of one RTX 4090, so a single minimum deposit funds a week of evening experiments; the deposit is prepaid balance, not a credit grant.

limits.value: Nothing runs before a deposit of at least USD 15 clears; there is no trial credit, so the first gate is money rather than identity.

identity_cost.detail: signup by Google, GitHub or email, then a deposit before anything runs: the billing step states 'Add initial credits (minimum $15, maximum $5,000 per transaction)' and 'Minimum deposit is $15', paid by card or USDC/USDT. The USD 15 is a minimum deposit of real money, not an authorisation hold, and there is no trial credit. Whether debit or prepaid cards are accepted is not stated

evidence.proved: billing step: payment by card or USDC/USDT, 'Add initial credits (minimum $15, maximum $5,000 per transaction)', 'Minimum deposit is $15', RTX 4090 about USD 0.52/hour
live rates across H100, H200, B200, B300, A100, GH200, L40S, RTX 5090 and RTX 4090, per-minute billing, no commitments
48 GPU configurations listed, 6 unavailable at read time, signup by Google, GitHub or email

notes: The site publishes no free credit; a third-party blog mentions a trial signup button, which the current flow does not show. On-chain settlement is described in the provider blog, not in the deployment docs, so the token side of the marketplace was not verified.
